links.outcome: Response consistency of LLM outputs across repeated runs on three separate days
links.effect: Response consistency was moderate for all models (κ=0.36-0.41).
links.quote: Response consistency was moderate for all models (κ=0.36-0.41).

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of general-purpose LLMs on scaphoid fracture detection from radiographs
links.effect: Claude 3.5 sensitivity 57.1%, Gemini 2.0 18.2%, ChatGPT-4o 9.1%; specificity 43.1%-43.8% across models.
links.quote: Claude 3.5 demonstrated superior sensitivity (57.1%) compared to Gemini 2.0 (18.2%) and ChatGPT-4o (9.1%) for fracture detection (p<0.001).

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of three commercial multimodal LLMs (Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0, ChatGPT-4o) on radiographs of scaphoid fractures without testing any organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
